p1: There's a photo on my phone of me asleep. Taken at 3:12 last night. I live alone.
I'm in bed by ten. My phone charges in the kitchen.
And I've never sleepwalked in my life.
Next night, another photo. 3:12 again. Closer.
So I left my phone filming the hallway.
At 3:12, my bedroom door opened, and I walked out.
Barefoot. I picked up the phone and carried it back to bed.
I laughed. I sleepwalk. Mystery solved.
Then I opened the photo it took.
It's me, in bed, asleep. Eyes shut.
So the man in the hallway, wearing my face...
That wasn't me. I've never sleepwalked in my life.
I sleep in my car now.
This morning, a new photo. Me, asleep at the wheel.
